notes.title: Update to version 1.4.0.
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Little Hearts or looking at the information with interest.
We are pleased to inform you that we have updated the game to 1.4.0.

The content of this update is that we have added conversations with each character in the information collection menu in the last chapter, and
After clearing the game, you can now view a commentary with the character's growth rate and other information.

Please note that English support will be available as soon as the translation is finished.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

Thank you for playing Little Hearts or looking at the information with interest.

Thank you for your continued support of Little Hearts.

notes.title: Update to version 1.3.0 English language support
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Little Hearts or looking at the information with interest.
This time we would like to inform you that the update is to 1.3.0.

The main content of this update is "English localisation support".

[h1]Players can now play in English[/h1].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40482651/637224dae09611b7cf3bdeaec0b3250006280312.jpg[/img]

The dialogue text and information in the window have been translated so that users who do not understand Japanese can now play the game without any problems as long as they can read English.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40482651/7a85573d345f93ce3459cc5322a2498e5649f9b3.jpg[/img]

If the Steam language setting is set to English, the English version will be downloaded, otherwise the Japanese version will be downloaded, but both versions can be downloaded from any country by setting the language in the Steam client's properties.

We hope that those who have been interested in the game but have not been able to play it in Japanese only will be able to play it.

This update is basically a localisation-only change, but we have also made some minor adjustments to message positions and other details to match some of the language support.

[h2]Accuracy of translation, and parts of the game that remain in Japanese, etc.[/h2].
The English version of Little Hearts has been localised using AI translation by DeepL.
Although we have tried to make the text as natural as possible by re-translating it, there may be some phrases that are not appropriate for the characters and some grammar may be unnatural.
In addition, line breaks to fit the width of the game window may be difficult to read.
We will do our best to address any obvious problems here.
We will be setting up a thread in the community for players of the English version of the game, so if you have any points to point out, please post them there.
(However, please note that we may not be able to respond to some of the personal preferences in expression.)
If there are parts of the game that are still in Japanese, we will fix them in an update as soon as we become aware of them.

22/12 23:20 added Update to 1.3.0a for English version only.
Fixed an error in chapter 4 where localisation was not applied
Changed wording of save text and manuals.
Fixed that the part displayed at the top of the UI was still in Japanese.

notes.title: Update to version 1.2.2
notes.notes:
Updated to version 1.2.2.
Implementation of a function to change resolution
By opening "game.ini" in the game installation folder with Notepad, etc. and changing "HardwareFullScreen=0" to 1, it is now possible to change the game screen resolution (screen size expansion) from the in-game preferences. 
(However, this function cannot be used with the mouse. this is a specification of the game development tool, so it is difficult to resolve this issue. Please understand.)

In accordance with the above, the access method to "game.ini" is now displayed when the game is started from the beginning and in the manual.

notes.title: Update to version 1.2.0
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Little Hearts or viewing the information with interest.
We are pleased to inform you that this update is to 1.2.0.

This update includes an update to the game.ini file. Basically, if you have not configured the file from your local files, there is no need to be concerned, but if you have made changes to the file, please reconfirm the contents.

[h1]Title screen update[/h1].
The title screen image has been replaced with a new one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40482651/23bd71516f4ab0dab4e7ed3171a3f2bee339f595.png[/img].

[h1]Added many conversations at the start of the battle. [/h1]
Added a number of conversations between the boss characters on each map and the two main characters when they first engage in battle.
We have added a number of conversations that take place between the characters when the two main characters first engage in battle with the boss characters present on each map.
Basically, conversations are now held between the named characters and the two main characters.
In addition, there are also conversations between some of the other characters.

[h3]Other fixes[/h3].
At the start of the extra mode, there was a text stating that there was a high difficulty ver MAP.
This text was left over from the beta version and is no longer playable.
This text was deleted because it is not playable at this time.


[h2]Future update schedule. [/h2]
First, we continue to work on the English version from before.
For this one, we have finished the translation of the main story and are in the process of starting the conversations at the bases and so on.
Although this is a machine translation, we will try to make it as accurate as possible by re-translating and so on.
We will try our best to avoid outputting text that is obviously abnormal.

Other
We would like to add and correct the fact that the battle backgrounds in some maps are not appropriate for the situation (e.g., a snowy mountain with a green floor and a mountain background).
We will be waiting for the above mentioned extra mode high difficulty vermap, but it is not impossible to release it immediately if it is the high difficulty vermap of chapter 5 that existed in the beta. It is not impossible to release it immediately if it is a high difficulty Ver.
In addition, the high-difficulty MAP here has been cleared. The high difficulty MAP will not affect clear points, and will have no more meaning than that only those who really want to do it can do it.
The following are some of the updates that we are planning for the future.

Thank you for your continued support of Little Hearts.
